mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.code,d.name,d.status,d.display_order,d.revision FROM post_category d WHERE 1=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_category_type t WHERE t.category_id=d.id AND t.post_type=#{type})
